note: Both sets read the values and quotes correctly, and neither invents anything. Set B additionally captures the functions of the two dichroics (the first reflects UV light, the second reflects visible light to the OAP), which Set A omits even though its path claim passes through them. Set B's only real flaw is restating each field-stop diameter twice (once under 'visible channel', once under the field stop itself), and its optical-path claim is truncated at the FSM where A gives the fuller path. On balance B covers more correct engineering content, with redundancy rather than error as its cost.
remarks: Both sets miss figure-label components that are arguably engineering facts: the Imaging EMCCD, Spectrum EMCCD and Calibration source shown in Figure 5.5-10. The many bare component claims whose entire quote is a figure label (UV Dichroic, Dichroic, Filters, Grism, OAP, Ellipse) are low-value but symmetric across the sets. The text layer drops the sentence continuation 'This focus is (Figure 5.5-11)', so the page fragment is cut off in both inputs.
